newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt interbank market active in Sunday trading.
newsitem.headline: Egypt interbank market active in Sunday trading.

text.p: Egyptian overnight rates ranged between 10-1/8 and 10-3/16 percent on Sunday in a moderately liquid beginning-of-week market, private-sector bankers said.
They also quoted one-week rates between 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent.
Bankers had said on Thursday that there was very little interbank trading on the pound due to end of week liquidity. One banker said he performed a deal at 9-3/4 percent.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
